Meta Liberation Army.text: A militant movement from the early years of the Quirk era. Led by a man called Destro, it demanded the right to use Quirks freely, calling every restriction an attack on a person's own body, and fought the government until it was crushed. Destro died in prison and the army was disbanded; today it shows up in documentaries and textbooks as a warning about Quirk extremism. Destro's writings still circulate among Quirk-rights activists and the curious. Officially it has had no members, no attacks and no leadership for decades, and most people file it under history. The visible contradiction: its central claim, that people should be free to use the power they were born with, still gets a sympathetic hearing on talk shows and online forums.
